groupsDesc.zh: 侧栏的会话按日期分成今天、昨天、星期几，最近的排在最上面，每行右手标出它属于哪个工作区；行里不再重复显示时间。关掉后回到按工作区分组。
groupsDesc.en: Sorts the sidebar's sessions into Today, Yesterday and weekday groups, newest first, each row tagged with its workspace; the row's own time goes away. Turning this off returns to grouping by workspace.
